title: Short Stirling W7441
memorial_details: description: Short, brick-built obelisk with a section of propeller mounted on the top.  Two slate tablets are mounted on the front and rear faces.  On the front, the RAF Marham crest and dedication are incised in white upper and lower-case letters.  To the rear, a side profile of a Stirling bomber, 7 Squadron crest and the dedication are similarly incised.
